//: T-037 — the same e2e suite as `test/jest-e2e.json`, run with coverage collection over
It exists because `test/jest-e2e.json` sets `rootDir: '.'` (the `test/` directory), and Jest
resolves `collectCoverageFrom` globs relative to `rootDir` — a `../src/...` glob from there
matches nothing, so `--coverage` on that config reports 0% for code that 73 passing tests
demonstrably execute. This config sets `rootDir` to the workspace root instead and adjusts
the two paths that depended on the old one, changing nothing else about how the suite runs.
It lives under `test/campaigns/` rather than beside `jest-e2e.json` because that file is not
this task's to edit (AGENT-PROTOCOL R9); `test/campaigns/**` is. AGENT-PROTOCOL §4's
coverage gate is what it is for: the service layer of this module is exercised end to end
against the real database, and this is how that shows up as a number.
